Venue Information Main Event ★

National Library of the Republic of Indonesia (Perpusnas RI)

Address: Jl. Medan Merdeka Sel. No.11, RT.11/RW.2, Gambir, Kecamatan Gambir, Kota Jakarta Pusat, Jakarta 10110

Google Maps →
Accommodation Pins #1 - #14

Self-Arranged Participant Lodging

Participants are responsible for arranging their own accommodation during their stay in Jakarta, as lodging costs are not included in the registration fee. You can book a hotel room using platforms such as Traveloka or other preferred hotel booking websites.

Currency & Payments IDR (Rupiah)

Cards, Digital Payments & Cash

While digital payments, debit cards, and credit cards are widely accepted in Jakarta, it is advisable to carry some cash for minor expenses. You can easily exchange currency at authorized counters upon your arrival at the airport.

Authorized money changers are available inside Soekarno-Hatta Terminal 3 arrival hall.
ARRIVAL LOGISTICS • SOEKARNO-HATTA INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (CGK)

Airport Transportation & Getting to the Venue

If you are arriving from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, use Option 1 or Option 2 to reach your hotel or the event venue:

Option 1 • Recommended Airport Metered Taxi

Official Blue Bird Taxi (Recommended)

  • Head to the official taxi queue area upon exiting Terminal 3 Soekarno-Hatta Airport and look for Blue Bird taxis.
  • You can ask the uniformed attendants (wearing blue shirts with the Blue Bird logo) standing near the queue to direct you.
  • Fares are metered based on distance and settled upon arrival at your destination.
Option 2 • Airport Rail Link

Airport Train & Commuter Rail

  • Take the Skytrain from Terminal 3 to the airport railway station.
  • Purchase a ticket to connect into central Jakarta (you can transfer or head toward stations near central Jakarta such as Manggarai or BNI City, depending on your route).
  • From there, continue your journey to the venue using a local taxi (such as Blue Bird) or by booking a ride via Gojek or Grab.
LOCAL CITY MOBILITY • CENTRAL JAKARTA & VENUE SURROUNDINGS

Transportation Around the Venue & City in Jakarta

For daily travel between your hotel, Perpustakaan Nasional RI, and around the city in Jakarta, use Option 3 or Option 4:

Option 3 • City Ride-Hailing

Ride-Hailing Apps (Gojek / Grab)

We strongly recommend installing Gojek or Grab from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store prior to your arrival for convenient mobile booking of car/motorbike rides and food delivery around the venue and across Jakarta.

Option 4 • City Public Bus

Transjakarta Public Bus

For a budget-friendly public transit option around the venue and city, you can use the Transjakarta (TJ) bus network. Tickets can be purchased directly at the station ticket counters.

Closest Stop to Venue: Pin #15 — Bus Stop Balai Kota (0.10 km, directly in front of Perpusnas RI).

Transit Planning Tip: You can also plan your exact transit route in real-time using Google Maps.
